rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of me, and sorry to give you a dull answer on a deadline: I can't give you anything on the record this week. Halcyon Threshold is a few weeks old and I still have a day job whose outside-activities policy I need to work through before I make public statements in connection with it. That's a process thing on my end, not reluctance to talk about the substance. Two small asks: 1. Please don't attribute remarks from the meetup to me by name in this piece — that was an informal room, and I'd rather not be quoted secondhand while this is unresolved. 2. If you're ever working on something on a longer timeline, I'd genuinely like to talk then. I expect to be able to speak on the record in a few weeks. Best of luck with the piece. Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Press (due tomorrow noon)** — declined on the record, and asked Tessa not to attribute your secondhand meetup remarks by name. **Sent**

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". I have a day job with an outside-activities and public-statements policy that I need to work through before I attach my name or Halcyon Threshold's to published advocacy.
